cryocoolers.note: fuel_loads.cooling.rejected_W is the input work; the lifted ~3.8 kW adds to it at the rejector (1 %).

avionics_allowance.note: LOW carries cryocoolers, computing, GNC, comms and the conversion losses; the 0.3 MW allowance is about ten times the computing estimate but covers the PMAD losses at proactive coast.

eye.note: EYE values are electrical inputs (laser input plus non-laser load); the ablation laser sends 1 MW out of the ship.

crown.note: Crown rows split electrical = optical + heat (wall-plug 0.5). The normal active band (15-30 MW electrical) includes the 10 MW Crown normal; 5 MW of it leaves the ship as light.

defense_bands.note: 17_POWER_STORAGE bands are electrical inputs; 40_THERMAL routes 15-30 MW of normal active defense heat to the warm loop: the same numbers, so the thermal band gives no credit for the Crown light that leaves the ship (conservative by up to 5 MW).

field_services.note: OPEN planning allowance from the thermal sheet; possibly inside the proactive band; kept OPEN.

repair_bus.note: Intermittent maintenance load after engagements; its duty is a doctrine (PARAM).

burn_heat_pumps.note: F02 sized 210 MW of drive electric work for 35 MW lifted (5 MW machinery + 30 MW defense heat at burnout). Since the Graded Thermal Blade the WARM section takes 5 MW of warm heat in every mode, and the Crown light leaves the ship, so the pumps lift only the warm heat beyond the section: the running work is computed here.

drive_standby_startup.note: Startup power comes from the pulse bank; standby and seed-coil power are OPEN.

phase1_reconciliation.note: Phase I: 0.8 MW ship service, 3.6 MW proactive coast, 26 MW active coast. Field services and drive standby are now OPEN items (planning bands apart), so the known totals fall by ~1.35 MW nominal.

faults.note: Every continuous generating unit lost (drive off): stores, then L3
Bus A faulted and isolated: A-only loads drop, dual-fed loads move to B
The survival bus faulted: L3 and the packs unavailable
Drive trips in a burn: burn bus lost with the hot loop still hot
